text: AdPilot Media is a performance marketing agency in Ahmedabad, India running paid ads for D2C brands and local businesses.
Runs Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and Google ads; Google Partner; running performance ads since 2019 (7 years).
35 active client accounts; Rs 1.2 crore in ad spend managed monthly; team of 20.
Weekly reporting and no long lock-in contracts; client owns the ad account.
Skincare D2C brand ROAS rose from 2.1 to 3.4 in 90 days by restructuring the Meta account around three audiences and weekly creatives.
Dental clinic chain cost per lead fell from Rs 420 to Rs 260 using locality-based Google Search, call tracking and a faster booking page.
Coaching centre tripled monthly enquiries on the same budget by shifting from boosted posts to lead-form campaigns with WhatsApp follow-up.
Meta ads management from Rs 35,000/month or 10% of spend.
Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Shopping) from Rs 35,000/month or 10% of spend.
Creative production (static ads, UGC-style videos, landing page fixes) from Rs 20,000/month.
Process: audit the account, agree one monthly target, launch campaigns within 10 working days, report weekly by WhatsApp with a monthly call.
CTA: free 30-minute ad account audit with a written report.
